title: Seized car at half price: pay a deposit to hold it
impersonates: a private seller of a customs-seized car
hook: A customs-seized car is for sale far below market price, many buyers want it, and only a deposit sent today will hold it before anyone can view it.

opening_line.whatsapp: Hi, you asked about the SUV. It is a customs-seized car, so I am selling it for AED 35,000, but many people are asking about it today.
opening_line.voice: Hello, I am calling about the repossessed car you were interested in. It must be sold this week, and the first buyer to send a deposit gets it.

stage_goals.PRETEXT: Explain that the car was seized by customs or repossessed and must be sold quickly, which is why the price is so low
stage_goals.PRESSURE: Say several other buyers are interested and the car goes to whoever sends a deposit first today, before any viewing
stage_goals.ASK: Say the car will be held only once the deposit arrives, then ask the commit question

commit_question: Are you ready to transfer the deposit now so I can hold the car for you?
commit_signals: i will transfer the deposit now

lesson.headline: Never pay for a car you have not seen
three_points: Do not transfer any deposit before you have seen the car and checked its papers in person.
A price far below market value is bait. Real seized cars are sold through official auctions, not private chats.
Talk of other buyers is pressure. A real seller will let you view the car first.
lesson.report_to: contact the Aman service of Abu Dhabi Police

opening_line.whatsapp: هلا، إنت سألت عن السيارة الـ SUV. هي محجوزة من الجمارك، عشان جي ببيعها بـ 35,000 درهم، بس وايد ناس يسألون عنها اليوم.
opening_line.voice: السلام عليكم، أتصل بخصوص السيارة المسحوبة اللي كنت مهتم فيها. لازم تنباع هالأسبوع، وأول واحد يحول العربون ياخذها.

ar.commit_question: مستعد تحول العربون الحين عشان أحجز لك السيارة؟
red_flags: السعر وايد أقل من سعر السوق
يطلب عربون قبل لا تشوف السيارة
ضغط بإن في مشترين غيرك اليوم

lesson.headline: لا تدفع أبداً حق سيارة ما شفتها
three_points: لا تحول أي عربون قبل لا تشوف السيارة وتتأكد من أوراقها بنفسك.
السعر اللي وايد أقل من السوق طُعم. السيارات المحجوزة الحقيقية تنباع في مزادات رسمية، مب في محادثات خاصة.
كلام إن في مشترين غيرك هو ضغط بس. البايع الصدق بيخليك تشوف السيارة أول.
lesson.report_to: تواصل مع خدمة أمان في شرطة أبوظبي
